name: load-harness-assets
description: Build-time only: compiles Tailwind CSS into src/load_harness/static/css/app.css and copies HTMX into src/load_harness/static/vendor/; both are committed so the image needs no Node.

scripts.build:vendor: mkdir -p src/load_harness/static/vendor && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js src/load_harness/static/vendor/ && cp node_modules/htmx.org/LICENSE src/load_harness/static/vendor/htmx.LICENSE
